# See the wiki page for an explanation of the params!
# https://github.com/GRChombo/GRChombo/wiki/Guide-to-parameters

#################################################
# Filesystem parameters
grteclyn.output_path = ./

amr.verbose = 1

# Ignored by non-GPU builds (ParmParse has no preprocessor, so this line is
# always active)
amrex.use_gpu_aware_mpi = 1

# Plotfiles default to <grteclyn.output_path>/plots and checkpoint files to
# <grteclyn.output_path>/checkpoints
# amr.check_file = checkpoints/chk
# amr.plot_file = plots/plt
# amr.restart = checkpoints/chk00030
# amr.file_name_digits = 5

# Number of level-0 time steps between checkpoint files; -1 disables output
amr.check_int = -1
# Number of level-0 time steps between plot files; -1 disables output
amr.plot_int = 15

amr.plot_vars = ALL
amr.derive_plot_vars = constraints InflationFields

#################################################
# Initial Data parameters

# Change the gravitational constant of the Universe!
# Default is 1.0, for standard geometric units. The value below is
# 1 / (8 pi * 10^4), i.e. it sets the reduced Planck mass 1/sqrt(8 pi G) to 100.
scalar_field.G_Newton = 3.9788735772973834e-06

# Background scalar field initial data
init.scalar_init = 1
init.tensor_init = 0

init.alpha = 0
init.random_seed = 3539263

# cutoff
init.use_window = 1
init.Delta = 1

init.background_phi = -1336.9327340184493
init.background_dphi = 0.01413970821831444

# Potential parameters
scalar_field.scalar_mass = 0.00017349447958987208

# Spectral input
init.use_stoiic_spectra = 1

#################################################
# Grid parameters

amr.n_cell = 64 64 64
geometry.prob_extent = 6623.001070099251 6623.001070099251 6623.001070099251

# Convergence test grid resolution bounds. Note that, unlike the other
# initialisation parameters, these are read from the top-level table.
# N_coarse = 32
# N_fine = 64

amr.max_level = 0 # There are (max_level+1) grids, so min is zero

# Regridding interval in level timesteps; -1 disables regridding
# Supply one shared value or max_level values, one per coarse-to-fine
# transition
amr.regrid_int = -1

# Maximum number of cells along each side of a grid box
amr.max_grid_size = 32
# Grid box side lengths must be divisible by this value
amr.blocking_factor = 16
# Minimum fraction of tagged cells required in generated grids
# amr.grid_eff = 0.7

# Number of cells by which tagged regions are grown
amr.n_error_buf = 0
# Proper-nesting width is n_proper * max(1, blocking_factor / 2) coarse cells
# amr.n_proper = 1

#################################################
# Boundary condition parameters

# Periodic directions: 0 = false, 1 = true
geometry.is_periodic = 1 1 1

#################################################
# Evolution parameters

# dt is dx * dt_multiplier on each grid level
evolution.dt_multiplier = 0.25
evolution.stop_time = 3162.2500752276246
# evolution.max_steps = 1000000

# Spatial derivative order (only affects the CCZ4 RHS)
evolution.spatial_derivative_order = 4

evolution.nan_check = true

# Lapse evolution
gauge.lapse_advec_coeff = 0.0 # 1.0
gauge.lapse_coeff = 0.0
gauge.lapse_power = 1.0 # 1.0

# Shift evolution
gauge.shift_advec_coeff = 0.0 # Usually no advection for beta
gauge.shift_Gamma_coeff = 0.0 #0.75
gauge.eta = 0.0 # 1.0 # eta of gamma driver, should be of order ~1/M_ADM of spacetime

# CCZ4 parameters
ccz4.formulation = 1 # 1 for BSSN, 0 for CCZ4
ccz4.kappa1 = 0.
ccz4.kappa2 = 0.
ccz4.kappa3 = 0.
ccz4.covariantZ4 = 0 # 0: keep kappa1; 1 [default]: replace kappa1 -> kappa1/lapse

# coefficient for KO numerical dissipation
evolution.sigma = 0.0

ccz4.min_chi = 1.e-30
ccz4.min_lapse = 1.e-30
